correctness.rationale: Exact hub decomposition proves the polynomial. A strict Rouché inequality on the circle centered at -1/3 counts m interior roots; real-axis monotonicity shows the unique exterior root <-2^m and a parity-dependent count. Eliminating the derivative gives a multiple-root quadratic with nonnegative real part for m>=3, excluded by the root positions, and direct low-degree counts handle m=1,2. The exterior equation proves X_m=2^m+m/2+O(m^2 2^-m). Möbius transformation and |w|^m=|z| prove uniform approach of all interior zeros to the boundary. Graph and Sturm checks independently passed 103 finite conditions; these supplement, not replace, infinite proofs.
